title: Behind tracy-web's mounts the passwords card's Sign out signs out of Tracy (303 to /login, no 302 loop, no 405/404), and the owner's directory-picker delete button reads its listing under /<site>/
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, with the stand's web image built from that commit: TRACY_STAND=<stand origin> TRACY_STAND_ENV=<stand .env with SESSION_SECRET> REG_OWNER_EMAIL=<an account owning a site on the stand> node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1085-passwords-mount-followups.mjs (REG_SITE picks the site; default the owner's first owned site).

S2 (card sign-out, HTTP with a cookie jar, redirects followed by hand): mint a Tracy session for the owner, GET <site>/ (a seat is minted), POST <site>/gateway/logout with Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin, follow every redirect; then GET <site>/gateway/login, the card's next stop, and follow it.
S3 (Tracy's own sign-out): with a second minted session, POST /auth/signout as a form (next=/login) and follow it.

S4 (picker, at the commit under test, no stand): node --import tsx --test test/tracy/picker-delete-mount.test.ts in vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords — it drives the real wrapped window.fetch of the picker with a mounted base tag. Not on the stand's page: a Tracy seat is never the dsh master and Tracy's bundles ship no picker dialog, and @tracy/dsh-brand's load tracker restores the window.fetch it captured, dropping any wrapper installed after it (measured 09/10, raised separately).
expect: The script exits 0 and prints 'ALL CHECKS PASSED'.
POST <site>/gateway/logout answers 303 with Location /login; no hop is a 405 or returns to /gateway/logout; the walk ends on /login answering 200; the tracy_sess cookie is cleared.
GET <site>/gateway/login ends on /login answering 200 with no 404 on the way, through /login?next=<encoded /<site>/>.
POST /auth/signout (form) still answers 303 to /login and clears tracy_sess.

Both picker-delete-mount tests pass: dshPathOf strips the page mount, and the owner's picker reads dsh's directory listing under /<site>/, /new/ and the root while ignoring a GET, another path and a longer path.
evidence: tasks/evidence/passwords-mount-followups/ — reg-before-2.7.7-tracy.6.txt: the tracy-srd stand on 2.7.7-tracy.6 (web from c86a714c19): POST /<site>/gateway/logout 302 back to itself, GET 405, tracy_sess kept, /<site>/gateway/login 404; picker-red-on-tracy.6-source.txt: the script with picker-delete.ts reverted to tracy.6. Original report: tasks/evidence/new-page-passwords-prefix/README.md ('Chưa giải quyết').
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/workspace/route.js: POST <mount>/gateway/logout forwards the held seat to dsh, then answers Tracy's sign-out (signOutCookies, 303 /login); GET <mount>/gateway/login redirects to <mount>/. vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords hook H16: picker-delete.ts strips the page mount (dshPathOf, src/client/tracy/page-base.ts) before upstream's exact pathname comparison; test/tracy/picker-delete-mount.test.ts and apps/tracy-web/test/proxy.test.mjs.
